summary: American Healthcare REIT filed an 8-K (Items 7.01, 8.01, 9.01) on June 18, 2026, announcing a quarterly distribution of $0.25 per share ($1.00 annualized) for Q2 2026, payable in cash on July 17, 2026, to holders of record June 30, 2026. The distribution, authorized by the board, is paid from legally available funds. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special-situation event. No other transactional, structural, or strategic actions are disclosed. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 contains no mention of mergers, acquisitions, tenders, or activist campaigns. The filing is a standard current report on dividend policy.
